Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the stomach-pain moment, add a physical reaction to show how severe it feels: “他的肚子疼得不得了，只好躺在地上。”
2. At the point where he finds plants interesting, add one observed detail to make his curiosity clearer: “他看见有的植物开着黄色的花，有的叶子又大又绿。”
3. Add an internal question after he feels pain to show his worry: “神农想：这种植物为什么让我肚子疼？”

ideas.reason: It adds a concrete physical reaction that fits his severe stomach pain.
It gives simple, relevant details that show why he is interested in plants.
It adds a natural thought that shows his concern about the harmful plant.
